        org 30000
start   ld a,7      ; BORDER
        out (254),a
        ld hl,msg
loop    ld a,(hl)
        and a
        ret z
        rst 16
        inc hl
        jr loop
msg     defm "hI, LD A"
        defb 13,0
        disp 40000
        ent

LOWER   LD A,B
1234567 x
a       b       c
        defm "A       B"
        nop ; X       Y
a                       b
x  y
